findings.title: Messaging design-time factory ignores the named MessagingDatabase connection input
findings.trigger: Invoke factory with only MessagingDatabase or ConnectionStrings__MessagingDatabase input and no DefaultConnection entry.

evidence.observation: Only DefaultConnection and its alias are checked before fallback.
EF script generation supplies service-specific environment keys.

findings.impact: Named target is ignored and Npgsql options can silently select a development fallback. Script generation may pass without proving target selection; no wrong-database operation was performed or claimed.
findings.recommendation: Align named per-service inputs and explicit precedence, fail safely when required target is missing, retain compatibility only where justified.
required_regressions: No-connect synthetic named Messaging target selection.
Environment/configuration precedence with decoy DefaultConnection and optional JSON/current directory.
Predictable missing input failure without silent development fallback.
Existing factory/EF script generation controls; no migration application.
